---
params:
  region: "Montréal"
  num_cols: 3
  data: '`r sp_list_fil_all <- read.csv2(file = file.path("~/Github_proj/evologie/InCubateur/2025_05_24_Guide_biodiv_qc","output/partie_2/sp_list_fil_all.csv"))`'
title: '`r sprintf("Observation d’espèces pour la région %s", params$region)`'
output: 
  html_document:
    self_contained: true
  # pdf_document: default
---

Observations de la faune du Québec par l'effort de toute le monde! 

```{r setup, echo=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)

# Filter by Region
data_filtered <- sp_list_fil_all %>%
  filter(MRS_NM_REG == params$region) %>%
  arrange(class, desc(n))
# Define the classes we want to display
target_classes <- c("Amphibia", "Squamata", "Testudines", "Mammalia", "Aves")
```


```{r run_script, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
# Loop through each class to create sections and grids
for (current_class in target_classes) {
  
  # Filter data for this specific section
  class_data <- data_filtered |> 
    filter(class == current_class)
  
  if (nrow(class_data) > 0) {
    # Create Section Header
    cat("\n##", current_class, "\n\n")
    
    # Start the Grid (using HTML for layout control)
    cat('<div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(', 
        params$num_cols, ', 1fr); gap: 20px;">')
    
    # Loop through species in this class
    for (i in 1:nrow(class_data)) {
      row <- class_data[i, ]
      
      # Generate the figure card
      cat(sprintf(
'<div style="text-align: center; margin-bottom: 20px;">
<a href="%s" target="_blank">
<img src="%s" style="width: 100%%; height: 100px; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer;" >
</a>
<p>
<strong>%s</strong><br>
<em>%s</em> (%s)<br>
<small>Observations: %s</small>
</p>
</div>',
# <img src="%s" style="width: 100%%; border-radius: 8px;">
row$url,
        path.expand(file.path("~/Github_proj/evologie/", row$fichier_photo)), 
        row$fr_nm, 
        row$species, 
        row$name_comm, 
        format(row$n, big.mark=" ")
      ))
    }
    
    cat('</div>\n\n') # End Grid
    cat("--- \n")    # Section Divider
  }
}

```
